title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1972-03-05
lineage: CD -> Cool Edit Pro v2.0 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Fair matrix recording with hiss, splices and occasional wow‑flutter but captures a spirited Winterland benefit highlighted by a smoking Good Lovin' and early Mind Left Body jam.
ai_review.review: The show is an uneven benefit set – the first half swings between sloppy moments and energetic highlights like Good Lovin', Tennessee Jed and a lively You Win Again, while the second set delivers a concise but sweet Not Fade Away → Goin' Down the Road sequence. The audio is a mixed soundboard/audience composite with noticeable hiss, splices and pitch irregularities that require EQ work, yet it remains listenable for fans interested in the early versions of several 1972 songs.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (~3.6) reflects a show with notable musical moments but inconsistent performance and a recording that is fair at best, leading to a mid‑range overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hissy, suppressed sound with occasional splices of audience material; some wow‑flutter and pitch issues; overall listenable but not crisp soundboard quality.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away > Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Benefit format with long opening acts truncated the Dead's set; first set uneven, second set short but sweet, overall pacing mixed.

band_member_comments.Phil: Strong bass work noted, especially on Jack Straw and driving Tennessee Jed.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux adds piano/organ pizzazz; Pigpen's organ featured prominently on Good Lovin' and You Win Again.
